title: WorkingMemory
description: Persistent personal memory for AI assistants — save, search, and recall across every MCP client.
summary: Persistent personal memory for AI assistants — save, search, and recall across every MCP client.
offersHint: Persistent personal memory for AI assistants — save, search, and recall across every MCP client. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://app.workingmemory.ai/mcp

toolsPreview.name: save_memory
toolsPreview.description: Save a thought, insight, fact, or todo to the user's Working Memory. The text is parsed and stored as one or more structured memory items, searchable a moment later via search_memory. Also use this when the user pastes memories or notes brought from another assistant — pass the full pasted text; it is split into individual memories automatically.

toolsPreview.name: search_memory
toolsPreview.description: Search the user's Working Memory for relevant past notes and facts. Use this when the user references something they may have stored earlier, or to find related context before answering. Always include your conversation id in client.conversation_id.

toolsPreview.name: manage_memory
toolsPreview.description: Manage an existing memory item. Currently supports deleting a memory by id (soft delete — recoverable for 30 days). Use search_memory to find the id first.

toolsPreview.name: capture_memory
toolsPreview.description: Capture durable facts from a task you just completed (drafting an email, summarizing a document, making a decision), as a byproduct — the user does nothing. Pass the task output/content; durable facts are extracted and stored automatically. Always include your conversation id in client.conversation_id. Returns immediately; extraction happens in the background.
